dogecoin.text: Initially, Memecoins were an experimental concept, with #Dogecoin, launched in 2013, being a prime example. Although it started as a joke, Dogecoin quickly gained attention in the crypto community due to its active online community and support from notable figures like Elon Musk.

Crypto Market Volatility: #Bitcoin and altcoins fell together, leading to $250 million in liquidations. Bitcoin dropped to the $66,000 range, while #Ethereum, #Solana, #Dogecoin, #Cardano, and #Chainlink saw declines of 6-9%.
